import numpy as np
def fitdeg(w,deg):
    C=np.cos(w*t);S=np.sin(w*t)
    mons=[x**i*v**j for i in range(deg+1) for j in range(deg+1-i)]
    A=np.column_stack(mons+[C*m for m in mons]+[S*m for m in mons])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.sum((dv_dt-A@c)**2)/np.sum((dv_dt-dv_dt.mean())**2),c

import numpy as np
def build(w):
    C=np.cos(w*t);S=np.sin(w*t)
    cols={'1':np.ones_like(t),'x':x,'x2':x*x,'v':v,'v2':v*v,'sv':np.sqrt(v),'sx':np.sqrt(x),'C':C,'Cv':C*v,'Cx':C*x,'S':S,'Sv':S*v,'Sx':S*x,'Cv2':C*v*v,'Cx2':C*x*x,'sinv':np.sin(v),'v3':v**3}
    return cols
def fit(w,names):
    cols=build(w)
    A=np.column_stack([cols[n] for n in names])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.sum((dv_dt-A@c)**2)/np.sum((dv_dt-dv_dt.mean())**2),c

import numpy as np
def fitset(w,names):
    C=np.cos(w*t);S=np.sin(w*t)
    cols={'1':np.ones_like(t),'x':x,'x2':x*x,'v':v,'v2':v*v,'sv':np.sqrt(v),'sx':np.sqrt(x),'C':C,'S':S,'Cvx':C*(v-x),'Svx':S*(v-x),'Cx2':C*x*x,'Sx':S*x}
    A=np.column_stack([cols[n] for n in names])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.sum((dv_dt-A@c)**2)/np.sum((dv_dt-dv_dt.mean())**2),c
